notes:
Real clip (window 2.4-3.6 s of S05.mp4): tight, level, eye-height close-up of the young man facing the lens, nearly frontal. Head (hair-incl.) ~0.42-0.43 W wide at the window start, ~0.47-0.49 W at the end (+12-15%): a slow push-in / lean-in, no pan or tilt, stable background. Face centre x ~0.47-0.48 W; hair top cropped by the top frame edge; the round yellow glasses sit ON THE EYES the whole window (y 0.37-0.49 H, 0.30-0.35 W wide, never move); chin ~0.80 H -> ~0.86 H; silver bomber jacket/collar fills the full width of the bottom 0.2-0.3 H. Hands: both at the glasses temples k=0-7 (x 0.05-0.35 and 0.65-0.9 W), the image-right hand drops out by k~14, the image-left hand curls into a point and extends to the lens as a big blurred foreground hand in the lower left (x 0.05-0.4, y 0.6-1.0 H) for k=21-28. Background: teal underground garage down the aisle: row of ceiling tubes converging at ~(0.55,0.46) (nearest at the top-right corner), concrete columns at x~0.86 W right and ~0.1-0.25 W left, only a faint dark car mass at the far left edge (x 0-0.17, y 0.43-0.65, k=21-28), floor in the lower third.
Previs (re-fit v2 after verifier round 1): lens 50 mm, camera level at z=1.911 on the aisle axis x=1.64 looking +Y; mannequin lifted 0.33 m (figure_path z) so the camera is at eye height under the 3.0 m builder ceiling (reproduces the real tube/beam/column positions); figure_yaw 180 (faces lens); camera dollies in 0.088 m (0.65 -> 0.562 m to the head centre: head ball 0.43 -> 0.48 W, centre ~(0.465,0.42), top cropped, chin ~0.83 -> ~0.90 H, i.e. +0.03..0.04 H below the real chin). CHANGES vs v1: (1) figure_action flick -> stand: the 'flick' gesture slid the visor down at k=10-12 (frame-difference spike 7x median) while the real glasses never move; with 'stand' nothing moves except the dolly (frame-diff series now 0.8-1.3x the median, no spike). (2) car_pos (-1.4,11) -> (-4.9,17): the legible grey car with wheels at x 0-0.3 is now a small dark car mass cropped by the left edge (x 0-0.12 W, y 0.55-0.75 H), like the faint dark mass in the real clip. Camera, lens, figure position unchanged (head size/centre/dolly/VP/tubes/columns were already within tolerance).
STILL MISMATCHED (all builder-bound, see BUILDER REQUESTS): (a) visor/glasses: the builder's visor sits on the forehead (VISOR_LOC z=0.138) - centre y 0.28 H (k=0) -> 0.23 H (k=28) vs real 0.43-0.45 H, i.e. 0.15-0.21 H too high for the whole window, and 0.39 W wide vs 0.30-0.35 W. It cannot be lowered with existing params: only the 'flick' action sets visor_dz (-0.034 m, at 0.42-0.52 s = the slide), no action holds it down from frame 0; lowering the figure/camera to put the visor on the eyes would push the chin to ~0.95 H and uncrop the head, so the head stays matched and the visor stays high. A camera elevated ~25 deg would also do it but breaks the level horizon. (b) no torso/shoulders/hands: shoulders are 0.225 m off-axis (frame half-width at head depth 0.234 m) and 0.05-0.11 m below the chin (jacket top is at the chin in the real clip), so the bottom third is a 0.12 W neck stalk with floor on both sides instead of a full-width jacket; arms (tested actions 'flick' and 'poses') land outside the frame or in the wrong place/time ('poses' puts both hands in the top corners at k=10-18). (c) head is a ball (no hair/face), VP 0.5 W vs real ~0.55 W, builder tubes thinner than the real bright tubes, floor ~20% farther below the camera than the real one (lifted-figure trick, uncorroborated).
BUILDER REQUESTS: (1) static glasses level: a previs key 'visor_dz' (m, applied from frame 0 for every action) and 'visor_w' (m): needed here visor_dz about -0.04 (visor centre ~0.015-0.02 m below the ball centre) and visor_w ~0.11-0.12 m, no animation. (2) close-up bust preset for shots where the head spans >0.35 W: shoulders/collar raised so the jacket top edge is at chin level and >= +-0.25 m wide (full frame width), neck short; e.g. keys 'torso_up' (m, raises the torso/shoulder meshes relative to the head pivot, here ~+0.08) and 'shoulder_w'. (3) hand poses visible in a close-up: 'hands_temples' (k=0-7: both forearms vertical, fingertips beside the glasses temples at x 0.2 W and 0.8 W of frame, y 0.3-0.55 H, 0.05-0.1 m in front of the face) -> image-right hand drops out of frame by k~14 -> 'point_lens' (image-left hand, index extended toward the lens, hand centre at x~0.22 W y~0.8 H, ~0.2-0.25 m from the lens, k=21-28). Needs per-pose timing keys (pose list with [t_s, name]) because 'poses' currently runs fixed lap/pA/pB/pC times. (4) optional: garage 'ceiling_z' override (real ceiling ~0.9 m above the eye -> ~2.55 m) so the +0.33 m figure lift is not needed and the floor is not too low; optional 'car: none' to drop the background car.
